messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary above to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The provided summary does not state or imply the exact years of backend engineering experience. To match the posting requirement ("8 years of backend engineering experience"), please supply the candidate’s total years of relevant experience.

Not providing this figure could result in the candidate being overlooked or rejected at the initial screening stage, as many recruiters and applicant tracking systems filter out resumes that do not explicitly meet stated experience requirements.
